name: 24590 · Scottsville, VA
findings: ZIP 24590 (Scottsville) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24590 (Scottsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24590 (Scottsville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
